climate: Most rain falls in winter. Dry summers keep mildew and rot down, though young vines may need watering.

blurb.text: A small north-central California AVA around two man-made lakes, Trinity Lake and Lewiston Lake, among steep timbered ridges and narrow valleys. The lakes cool the days and warm the nights. Only 30 acres were planted in 2005, with two wineries.
